title: Fast Response Time
description: The system shall return normal interactive requests within the target response time under normal operating load.
rationale: Fast feedback is important when students search and register.

title: Registration Performance
description: The registration service shall remain responsive and correct when many students submit registration requests during a peak registration window.
rationale: Registration opening periods can generate concentrated traffic.

title: System Availability
description: The system shall remain available during scheduled registration periods except for planned maintenance.
rationale: Students need reliable access during time-critical registration.

title: Authentication Security
description: Credentials and authenticated sessions shall be protected against unauthorized access; protected functions shall require a valid authenticated context.
rationale: Academic and personal data must be protected.

title: Role-Based Authorization
description: The system shall enforce least-privilege access for Student, Lecturer and Administrator roles across UI routes and backend/API operations.
rationale: Role separation protects administrative and lecturer-scoped data.

title: Data Integrity
description: Registration, enrollment-count changes and related notification creation shall be transactionally consistent.

title: Input Validation
description: User and administrator inputs shall be validated for required fields, valid values, identifiers and business constraints before persistence.
rationale: Validation reduces corrupt or unsafe academic data.

title: Usability
description: The registration workflow shall clearly present course details, validation errors, successful registration results and available actions.
target_value: All critical messages actionable and understandable
rationale: Students need to make decisions quickly and correctly.

title: Maintainability
description: Business validation logic shall be separated into reusable service/domain functions and covered by automated tests where practical.

title: Auditability
description: Administrative changes and important registration state changes should be traceable to the responsible user and operation when audit logging is enabled.
